what: Grad-CAM off-retina attention for ONE model under three objectives.

finding.reading: The choice of scalar to differentiate moves total off-retina attention by 26.3 percentage points on identical images and identical weights. Off-retina attention is therefore NOT a model-intrinsic property, and comparing two models measured under different objectives says nothing about either. It remains useful for what it was built for: flagging an individual map whose evidence sits off the retina.
